flow.name: simplified-flow-example
flow.description: Minimal flow demonstrating core concepts calling a llm step.

string.name: target
string.description: A filepath to the codebase the complexity calulation should run in

agent.name: analyzer
agent.prompt: You are a skilled code complexity analyzer.

step.prompt: Analyze the codebase in the `${input.target}` path and provide a complexity score. Use the gocyclo executable as `gocyclo -avg ${input.target} | grep Average`. Then use the `set_output_field` tool like `set_output_field("complexity_score", <score>)` to provide the output as float value. Then use the `emit_log` tool to give the user feedback about how well you were doing the job.
